# Upstream workflow reference

These files are retained from `chthollyphile/folia-major` for provenance and reference. GitHub Actions only loads workflows from `.github/workflows/`, so none of the workflows in this directory runs.

This fork uses its own checks and manual desktop artifact build. Upstream scheduled releases, Docker publishing, AUR publishing and triage require their original maintainers' infrastructure and credentials. Review and adapt them before enabling any of them here.
